1.Description:
Starting from a dense forest, this route weaves through the trees along the northern face of a nameless mountain range, following the gap between the rolling hills and the ancient civilization's stone pillar formations, eventually reaching a mysterious temple deep in the forest.
    The depths of the primeval forest teem with dangers, yet there may be fine opportunities lurking amongst the danger.

2.Description:
Starting from a large freshwater lake, this route crosses a gorge and follows a river. Make sure to be careful of the rapid river currents. Then, step through a sparsely wooded meadow and finally reach a mysterious temple deep in the forest.
    Water sources often nurture civilizations, so following rivers upstream to find the source of civilization is a very smart move.

3.Description:
Starting from a grassy area among sparse trees, this route penetrates deep into a large complex of ruins left by an ancient civilization, and then passes along the western flank of the mountain range before finally reaching a mysterious temple deep in the forest.
    There may be further clues about the treasures amidst the ancient ruins.

1.Description: Head out from the long-abandoned market, venture through the barren wasteland that is long devoid of any vegetation, and then follow the old railway tracks that once carried mine carts into the heart of the mountain. One may need to divert their path many times, as they find themselves veering away from the treacherous, broken tracks. With the railway tracks as your guide, this might just be the easiest route of them all.

2.Description: Head out from the burning town, and pass through the town market which was once the economic heart of the settlement, and continue on the paved road as you make your way forward towards the mine. Although nobody lives here any longer, the scattered remnants of the townsfolk that still remain may be resourceful.

3.Description: Start your journey from the wilderness just outside of town. Hack your way through the smoldering forest, and the black, unyielding smog that suffocates the landscape, and then claw your way up the mountain ridge into the mountain mine. This was a place once rich in resources which have been burned to a cinder, leaving nothing of use behind. But owing to that reason, this route could well be a shortcut.

1.Description: The hot spring at the foot of the mountain is the most obvious landmark on the route. Take the path winding around the hillside, which offers a panorama of the best views of the area. Travelers trekking against wind and snow will find welcomed warmth at the cluster of hot springs along the way.

2.Description: Despite being a difficult journey, it is good that there are wooden houses left by treasure hunters who have been here before, offering safety in a strange region. Because of the blisteringly cold wind and the heavy snowfall, treasure hunters get a sense of comfort in the most basic of shelters.

3.Description: Climbing from the foot of the mountain to the middle of the mountain, plants can be seen growing tenaciously on the rugged slopes. Only by surviving these dangers, facing the howling cold winds and the snow-covered forests, can one find the legendary treasure waiting in the white expanse.

1.Description: This road starts from the outer edge of the swamp and is covered with hard, bare stones. Water and vegetation are the sparsest here, offering a sweeping view of the scenery. However, the weathered skeletons along the way send a chilling warning to adventurers: Be careful, as murder is rife on the path to treasures.

2.Description: Depart from the dark pond and follow the water flow to enter the swampland and find the treasures. The water shrouds the area in thick fog, making it easy to hide yourself and evade attack. But should you become lost, you are fated to be swallowed by the marshes.

3.Description: Plants grow abundantly in the southeast of the swamp. If you set off on your treasure hunt from here, you need not worry about supplies. But the chirping birds and fragrant blooms will soon reveal a ferocious side. Finding a safe route through various poisonous flora and fauna will be the ultimate test for adventurers.
